description: Pass 2 correctness review found no new P0/P1/P2 bugs introduced by the pass-1 fixes. One pre-existing ambiguity noted: pipeline.rs group-level transient failures (list_tips fail, crdt_append fail for all groups) count as 'filtered' in rnews_main, not 'transient', so UUCP retry logic does not fire. This pre-dates the fix; the fix did not introduce it. The 1ms fallback comment in pipeline.rs misstates its rationale (1ms is equally GC-expired as 0ms from the epoch) but the branch is unreachable in production. Arc<AnyPool> removal is safe; AnyPool::clone is O(1). extract_body_msgid delegation preserves non-folded semantics.
title: Pass 2: no new actionable issues
